note: Gates come in kinds. table: combinational, a truth table ('inputs:outputs', bits in pin order). sequential: state bits, a next-state table keyed 'state|inputs' (clock excluded) and an output table keyed by state; with clock and edge it moves only on that edge. threshold, compare and hysteresis read levels as well as bits; their params (weights, theta, low, high) are defaults an instance may override in config.logic. With buffer, not, true and false, the ten named two-input tables cover all sixteen Boolean functions of two inputs.
